facts.fact: Crown survey designations: Kiran's Elbow is Point 4410 (matches F633); Tamar's Shoulder is Point 4392.
The council grain slate has gone up by one sack since the last count, according to Chetu's boy.
Ila watched the Winter Crossing Law cut from twenty-six lines to eleven; Kunal argued for ten spans of rope and asked 'whose arm' when she said eight.
Ila decides to keep the void out of tomorrow's council until she knows what it is, at a cost to her creed that a map is true or false.
